title: Still open
summary: Some 2019 headaches moved. The important ones are still open.

cards.text:
Teaching deep stacks got ordinary.
Fair energy numbers did not.

A local rule with the reach of the full diary
is still not on the shelf.

question.prompt: Which problem is still wide open?
choices: A local rule as powerful as the full diary
question.why: Local and powerful have not been shown to be the same tool.
question.simpler: Tavanaei’s 2019 list is a map. Annotate what later levels moved. Do not pretend the review predicted them.

question.prompt: A 100× energy claim is ready to repeat if it names no baseline.
question.why: Name the task, the accuracy, and both machines.
question.simpler: A ratio with no baseline is not yours to carry.

recall.question: Is a local learning rule as powerful as backpropagation a solved problem?

deeper.note: The survey is the map, not a verdict on later papers. The last page of this course is your own annotation of what moved.

paper.title: Deep learning in spiking neural networks
paper.section: The challenges section. Read it as a 2019 list.

terms.plain: local, and as strong as backprop
terms.definition: The open problem of a learning rule that uses only nearby spikes and still trains deep networks as well as backpropagation.
